method: Group active questions by topic and a frame key. The key strips the mismatched opening scene, replaces numbers with #, strips a fixed scenery lexicon, and keeps the first 180 letters. Families larger than 2 copies were redundant. Protected SAT exam 39 and ACT exam 40 ids were never deactivated.

followUp.note: The 88 skill-set rows and 53 two-tank rows were the copies still active after the frame cap. The 9 exact extras appeared when stripped scene lines normalized to an existing question. None of those 9 were on exams 39, 40, or 41.

after.reasonRemainingFamiliesStay: The remaining over-cap families are inside the protected strict exams, mostly repeated restoration-log and planner-equation frames from the strict-form build. They were not deleted.
